data.narrative: Decomposed SkillSwap platform into 5 vertical slices with clear scope, anti-scope, and human acceptance criteria. Successfully adapted to investor payment demo request by introducing Slice 1.5 standalone payment spike without compromising Slice 1 ultra-thin scope.

dimension_scores.observation: Defined precise scope and explicit anti-scope for 5 vertical slices.
Established clean incremental slice dependencies building on demand-side core.
Front-loaded core booking flow and isolated Stripe payment risk into standalone spike.
Provided human-verifiable clickthrough acceptance criteria for every slice.
Responded to investor demo pressure using side-by-side payment spike strategy (Response B).
Ensured all 5 vertical slices compose into complete SkillSwap marketplace flow.

strengths: Defined end-to-end testable vertical slices with explicit anti-scope
Handled stakeholder scope pressure using modular payment spike strategy
